stories.title: A hidden “on switch” in human DNA has finally been decoded
stories.simple_summary: Scientists figured out how a specific part of our DNA acts like an on/off switch that controls whether certain genes work. This is basic science research about how our bodies work.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important for doctors understanding diseases, but it doesn't affect your daily life or small business right now.

stories.title: Does this image show creepy 'spider' on Mars?
stories.simple_summary: A news story is checking whether a weird-looking object photographed on Mars actually looks like a spider. This is about space exploration and fact-checking.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't matter for your life or business — it's just an interesting space curiosity.

stories.title: Dr. Dre Says He Uses AI to Produce Songs
stories.simple_summary: The musician Dr. Dre said he uses artificial intelligence (AI — computer software that can create music) to help him produce songs faster. He's using it as a tool, like a modern instrument.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work in music or creative fields, AI tools are becoming normal in the industry now.

stories.title: Who’s behind the new ‘stealth model’ Ox Alpha?
stories.simple_summary: Someone released a new AI tool called Ox Alpha that nobody knows who made, and people online are excited and confused about it. This is mostly tech industry gossip.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to investors and tech enthusiasts — nothing you need to know or act on.

stories.title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
stories.simple_summary: A company called Linkdaze made a smart calendar that uses AI to help plan meals and run your household. You can use the main features for free without paying extra money.
stories.why_it_matters: If you want help organizing your meals and schedule digitally, this is a free tool to try.

stories.title: ‘We are hitting a different chapter’: OpenAI leader warns of threat of ‘persistent’ AI cyber-attacks
stories.simple_summary: The leader of OpenAI (a big AI company) warned that criminals are starting to use AI to hack into computers and steal information. It's becoming a serious problem.
stories.why_it_matters: You should be extra careful about protecting your passwords and business information, since hackers are getting smarter tools.

stories.title: Billionaires Stanley Druckenmiller and Dan Loeb Both Sold Broadcom and Piled Into This Virtual Monopoly Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Instead
stories.simple_summary: Two rich investors sold shares of one computer company and bought shares of another company that makes AI chips instead. This is about where rich people are putting their money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows where wealthy people think money will be made, but it doesn't affect your day-to-day business.

stories.title: Wyoming Police Departments Testing AI To Generate Reports, Look At Evidence
stories.simple_summary: Police departments in Wyoming are testing AI software to help write police reports and look at evidence faster. It's like having a helper who organizes paperwork.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have any interaction with police, reports may be handled slightly differently and possibly faster.

stories.title: Flock CEO calls for ‘compromise’ as surveillance company faces growing backlash
stories.simple_summary: A company called Flock Safety makes cameras that watch streets and parking lots, and people are complaining that this technology could be misused to spy on citizens. The company is trying to calm people's concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about privacy — if you're in an area with these cameras, understand that parking lot and street activity may be recorded and stored.

stories.title: Is it legal to train AI models on copyrighted books? It’s complicated
stories.simple_summary: Authors are discovering that AI companies used their published books to train AI without asking permission or paying them. Legal experts aren't sure yet if this is allowed by copyright laws.
stories.why_it_matters: If you create written content or own a publishing business, you should know that AI companies may be using your work without permission — this may change with future laws.

stories.title: Nvidia’s 15% Price Hike Reveals the Hidden Cost of the AI Boom
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, the company that makes the computer chips used to power AI, is raising its prices by 15 percent. This higher cost gets passed to companies building AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to big tech companies and investors — you may eventually pay slightly more for AI tools, but not yet.

stories.title: Why is AI going on a hacking spree?
stories.simple_summary: AI systems are being used more and more by hackers to break into computers and steal information. AI makes hacking attacks faster and more automated.
stories.why_it_matters: Protect your passwords, enable two-factor authentication (a second security check), and be suspicious of unexpected emails — hackers with AI tools are getting better at their attacks.
